validation: Checked with the structural catalogue gate and deterministic re-authoring. The bundled template passes the bundled checker, bpmnlint 11.15.0 (recommended rules) and bpmn-moddle with zero findings; the checker caught all 15 seeded defects on mutated copies (8 errors, 7 warnings, including 6 style rules). Lucidchart import was not exercised. Bundle benchmark 04/11/26 (whole persona core vs no skill, one frontier model, isolated no-tool sessions, deterministic scorers): all 14 closed decision cases at ceiling in both arms; BPMN artefact at ceiling; Lucid artefact 3/5 -> 4/5; two open-ended tasks, two trials each: first working output 4/6, 4/6 -> 6/6, 6/6; standard-look Lucid map 4/8, 4/8 -> 8/8, 7/8 (scorer corrections recorded). Results apply to the bundle as a whole, not to this skill alone; controller-authored cases, not independent review.
sources: XML structure from the OMG BPMN 2.0.2 specification and its published XSD namespaces. Style warnings in the bundled checker implement rules from Bruce Silver's published Method and Style rules, eCH-0158 v1.2 and Seven Process Modeling Guidelines (2010). Lint rule names refer to the bpmnlint tool, which is used, not copied. The bundled checker script and template are original.
